status: ACCEPTED 0.1.0 (2026-10-24, D1 canonical determinism; candidate for review): stdout-route specification frozen from the five registered 2.1.304 stdout recordings; it replaces the 2.1.303 sdk specification the 2.1.304-stdout entry named, against which every one of these recordings drifts (the canonical-conformance gate, category 6). Drift reports propose changes, review accepts them by editing this file and bumping specification_version

applies_to.launch_mode: claude -p <prompt> --output-format stream-json --verbose, launched by CliCapture (and the retained 2.1.304 binary for the MCP runs)
applies_to.capture_route: raw standard output read by CliCapture, independent byte copy
applies_to.route_limit: stdout only; the session file is a separate source with its own specification (session-transcript/2.1.304.json); interactive or input-stream-json control messages were not exercised

limits: one CLI version and one launch mode per profile: the inventory is an observed shape at the stated versions, not a vendor promise
a field observed in one record is not universal; a field absent from a specimen is not removed; nullability is what was seen
variants are discriminated by the vendor's own fields; a record with a new discriminator value is a new variant, not an error
data-keyed subtrees (tool inputs, tool-defined results, tool schemas, per-tool wire inputs) are tool/user data: only value kinds are recorded
a change of meaning under an unchanged shape is not visible to this inventory; the semantic oracle judges values
the stdout route: every line the CLI wrote, in order; five recordings, one of them cancelled, so a variant the CLI emits in other modes (input-stream-json control, hooks, compaction) is not described

external_cross_checks.name: Claude Agent SDK 0.3.304 sdk.d.ts (the StdoutMessage union), as pinned by 2.1.304-vendor-inventory.json
external_cross_checks.use: family-level comparison by VendorStreamInventoryTest; the disposition catalog keeps vendor-declared members no recording carries as unexercised

availability.rule: agent-journal/source-availability 0.1: token usage is present on this route; the Agent tool's result reports the child run's usage inside the data-keyed tool_use_result, a reviewed exception because the canonical-obligation catalog (obligations.json, claude.stream.usage.child-run.agent-result) maps it and classifies its other token-named members

families.granularity: per API message (assistant message.usage, provisional on this route), per run and per model (result usage, modelUsage), and per child run (task_progress and task_notification usage.total_tokens; the Agent result's tool_use_result.usage)

data_keyed_exceptions.reason: on an Agent result the members are Claude Code's own (agentId, usage, totalTokens, ...), not tool-defined data: their token usage is judged by the obligation catalog, so the detector's hidden-usage rule does not apply; on other tools the subtree stays tool-defined data
